basic_details.job_title: IREL Tradesman Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 131 Posts

how_to_apply: Visit the official website of IREL (India) Limited at www.irel.co.in.
Locate Advertisement No. IREL/CO/HRM/36/2026 for Tradesman Trainees.
Read the detailed recruitment advertisement and verify eligibility for the selected trade.
Open the advertisement-specific online application link provided by IREL.
Complete the online application according to the official portal instructions.
Retain the application acknowledgement or confirmation, if generated by the portal.
Candidates should refer to the detailed notification for document-upload requirements, applicable fees, verification instructions and any other mandatory application steps.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in IREL Tradesman Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IREL (India) Limited has announced 131 Tradesman Trainee vacancies under Advertisement No. IREL/CO/HRM/36/2026.

faq.question: Q2. Which trades are included in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Fitter, Electrician, Instrumentation and Attendant Operator Chemical Plant trades.

faq.question: Q3. How many Fitter vacancies are available?
Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Where can candidates check the educational qualifications?
faq.answer: The trade-wise qualifications, experience requirements and other eligibility conditions are available through the detailed advertisement referenced on the official IREL website.

faq.question: Q6. Where can candidates apply for IREL Tradesman Trainee Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the IREL Careers Portal and locate Advertisement No. IREL/CO/HRM/36/2026.
